segments.name: e-commerce operations
segments.description: Operates Hepsiburada, a hybrid first-party and third-party e-commerce platform in Türkiye, selling products and providing delivery, fulfillment, payment and advertising services to consumers and merchants.
segments.evidence: Our Company is comprised of one reportable segment, namely e-commerce operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers and merchants pay for products sold on the platform and for marketplace commissions, delivery, fulfillment, payment and advertising services.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our merchants a seamless set of end-to-end e-commerce solutions which include our last-mile delivery services including oversized products delivery under Hepsijet

changes.text: In 2024, the HepsiExpress operations were discontinued.
changes.evidence: now exclude orders for digital products and orders made on HepsiExpress, whose operations were discontinued in 2024
